steps.title: Configure App Metadata
steps.description: Establish basic identifiers including application name and package namespace com.cctvrecordbook.app.

steps.title: Define Database and Calculation Schema
steps.description: Configure api_schema.json with online collections, field descriptors, and balance calculation logic specifications.

steps.title: Establish Android Manifest
steps.description: Set up application structural configurations, declare activities, and request internet access rights. Removed deprecated package attribute from manifest tag and fixed main theme to material light.

steps.title: Configure Android SDK Compilation Settings
steps.description: Establish target SDK 34 compatibility, setup namespace attributes, and define Java 1.8 compatibility features.

steps.title: Define UI Application Colors and Styles
steps.description: Configure color scheme with customized material themes to ensure standard material lightweight appearance.

steps.title: Create Layout Background Assets
steps.description: Design custom rounded visual background configurations for cards, dynamic inputs, and primary control elements.

steps.title: Design Interactive Activities XML Assets
steps.description: Create layouts for User Signup/Login, Customer Database Dashboard, Record Creator Form, and detailed Information View. Fixed `layout_width` typo from `match_match` to `match_parent` in `activity_login.xml`.

steps.title: Develop Native Object Models
steps.description: Create Customer.java entity representing installation attributes, containing JSON parsing adapters.

steps.title: Implement Cloud Network SDK Client
steps.description: Create BackendApi.java which parses internal assets metadata and establishes safe CRUD interfaces to server endpoints.

steps.title: Implement Authentication Flows
steps.description: Write LoginActivity.java executing network-based login and registration operations with secure local session preservation.

steps.title: Implement Database Listing Screen
steps.description: Write MainActivity.java showing dynamic installation cards, aggregate analytics calculations, and real-time textual searching features.

steps.title: Implement Form Creator and Verification Flows
steps.description: Create AddEditCustomerActivity.java with dynamic real-time local mathematical calculation and remote validation check features.

steps.title: Implement Individual Details and Operations Action Screen
steps.description: Write CustomerDetailsActivity.java containing instant telephone calling intent and remote data deleting operations.

steps.title: Building CCTV Record Book
steps.description: Trigger final Gradle compilation to build and generate the debug Android application package.
